items.headline: Polymarket Moves Crypto Bets to Chainlink $LINK
items.summary: Polymarket is shifting its hourly and daily crypto markets to $LINK-powered oracles, using 60-second average prices for settlement. A big DeFi adoption win for Chainlink.

items.headline: $ETHFI Tumbles 25%, Doubling Bitcoin's Weekly Loss
items.summary: $ETHFI is down 25% in a week and 32% over four weeks, while Ether.fi's staking TVL slid about 11%. Restaking tokens are under heavy pressure.

items.headline: Coinbase Brings $MORPHO Onchain Loans to New York
items.summary: Coinbase is expanding its Morpho-powered onchain crypto loans to New York users. Another big regulated-market push for $MORPHO's DeFi lending rails.

items.headline: Paytaca Warns $BCH Wallet Users After Attacks
items.summary: Bitcoin Cash wallet Paytaca flagged two backend attacks where attackers created fake orders and payment requests. Private keys stayed on users' devices, but $BCH users should stay alert.

items.headline: $USD1 Supply Falls 11% Below $3 Billion
items.summary: World Liberty Financial's $USD1 stablecoin shed 11% of supply in a week, hitting a 30-day low with declines across Solana, Ethereum and BNB Chain.
